title: Navettes publiques et parkings — Grand Raid de La Réunion 2026
claims: A free shuttle runs from the ZAC Canabady car park in Saint-Pierre to Ravine Blanche on Thursday 15 October from 17:00 to 23:30, with no reservation needed.
A free shuttle runs between Bourg-Murat and the Nez de Bœuf area every 30 minutes from Thursday 18:00 to Friday 12:00, for relay runners and supporters.
A CIREST shuttle serves the Sentier Scout and Salazie sector on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 October.
An RF08 shuttle serves the Maïdo summit from Friday 16 at 12:00 to Saturday 17 at 20:30.
An Ilet Savannah shuttle runs from the Expobat car park from Friday 16 at 15:30 to Sunday 18 at 00:00.
SODIPARC and Citalis run shuttles to the Stade de La Redoute from Thursday 15 to Sunday 18 October.
The page describes six separate shuttle and parking arrangements for the 2026 edition.
